apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged once per run (Apify synthetic start event; priced per GB of run memory, 1 GB minimum). Target ~$0.001 for a typical 256 MB–1 GB start.

page-checked.eventDescription: Charged once per URL that was successfully fetched and hashed (including first-seen and unchanged pages). Failed network/DNS/timeout/SSL checks are free unless chargeFailedChecks is enabled.

page-changed.eventDescription: Charged once when a successful check detects a content-hash change vs the previous snapshot (not charged on first-seen). Stacks with page-checked.
